*Activates the Entrance Animation when there is another "Realm of
Gods" Category ally on the team upon the character's entry*
- {passiveImg:once}Damage reduction rate 30%{passiveImg:up_g} for 1 turn
- {passiveImg:once}Foresees enemy's Super Attack for 3 turns
- {passiveImg:once}{passiveImg:forever}DEF 510%{passiveImg:up_g}
*Basic effect(s)*
- Ki +2 and ATK & DEF 300%{passiveImg:up_g}
- Guards all attacks
- Great chance of launching an additional Super Attack
- "Realm of Gods" Category allies' DEF 30%{passiveImg:up_g}, plus an additional
ATK & DEF 50%{passiveImg:up_g}, chance of performing a critical hit & chance of
evading enemy's attack 25%{passiveImg:up_g} and damage reduction rate 10%{passiveImg:up_g}
for characters who also belong to the "Planetary Destruction" Category
- Chance of evading enemy's attack 10%{passiveImg:up_g} for allies whose names
include "Whis"
*When there is a "Realm of Gods" Category enemy*
- Ki +3 and ATK 300%{passiveImg:up_g}
- Launches an additional Super Attack
- "Realm of Gods" Category allies' ATK 30%{passiveImg:up_g}, plus an additional
ATK 50%{passiveImg:up_g} and chance of performing a critical hit 25%{passiveImg:up_g} for
characters who also belong to the "Planetary Destruction" Category
- ATK & DEF 100%{passiveImg:up_g} for allies whose names include "Whis"
*When there are no "Realm of Gods" Category enemies*
- Great chance of Ki +3 and ATK 300%{passiveImg:up_g}
- Great chance of launching an additional Super Attack
- Damage reduction rate 20%{passiveImg:up_g} before attacking
*When attacking*
- ATK 200%{passiveImg:up_g}
*When receiving an attack*
- DEF 250%{passiveImg:up_g}
*After receiving or evading an attack*
- ATK 200%{passiveImg:up_g} and chance of performing a critical hit 30%{passiveImg:up_g} for
4 turns
*When receiving an Unarmed Super Attack*
- Great chance of nullifying it and countering with tremendous power
- Nullifies it and counters with ferocious power when there is a
"Realm of Gods" Category enemy
